newsitem.title: DENMARK: NatWest retains buy recommendation on SAS.
newsitem.headline: NatWest retains buy recommendation on SAS.

text.p: NatWest securities on Wednesday said that despite poor first quarter results by Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) it was keeping its assessment of the share at an unchanged "buy".
"SAS' profits collapsed in the first quarter as a result of flat volumes, high fuel costs and lower disposal gains," NatWest wrote in a company update received by Reuters.

"However volumes are rebounding, the price of fuel is sharply lower and cost control measures will kick in through the summer. Therefore, although we have downgraded our forecasts by five percent, we remain confident that the 1997 result will match that of last year. Buy," it added.
SAS last month reported a first quarter 1997 loss of 269 million Swedish crowns, compared to 311 million crowns profit in the same period the year before.
But it stuck to an earlier forecast of full-year profit similar to last year's 1.815 billion Swedish crowns.
